title: Cyclic-gap Jensen isolates two parity polygon contacts

statement.quantifiers: m=N-1>=2,R>0; smooth positive singular phi with phi prime<0,phi second>0.

assumptions: Angles in(0,2pi), distinct vertices; pair counting includes both q and m-q.
